refnamediv.refpurpose: Configure the DNS settings of a link

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Resolve.Link is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

This is the per-link half of io.systemd.Resolve5: it lets a network configuration manager push the DNS configuration of a link to the resolver. Implementations exist in both systemd-resolved.service8 and systemd-networkd.service8: on the former the settings are applied to the resolver state of the link, on the latter they are applied to the link configuration and saved, so that a later restart of networkd restores them. SetDNS() replaces the DNS server list of the link identified by ifindex, taking DNSServerContext entries (server address, address family, optional port, interface index and TLS server name), and SetDomains() replaces its search and route domain list, taking SearchDomainContext entries (name, and routeOnly for routing-only domains).

SetLLMNR() and SetMulticastDNS() set the link protocol mode. The ResolveSupport enumeration selects disabled (no), enabled (yes) or resolve-only (resolve). SetDNSOverTLS() sets the DNS-over-TLS mode. DNSOverTLSMode selects no, yes or opportunistic. SetDNSSEC() sets the DNSSEC mode. SetDNSSECNegativeTrustAnchors() replaces the negative trust anchors of the link, and SetDNSDefaultRoute() makes the link usable as default route for DNS lookups. RevertDNS() resets all per-link DNS settings to their defaults. A link that is not ready yet is reported with InterfaceNotReady, and the request can be retried later. The resulting state is visible through resolvectl1, and IsLoopback and ManagedByNetworkd report how the link is set up.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: The interface is served by systemd-resolved.service8 on the /run/systemd/resolve/io.systemd.Resolve socket and by systemd-networkd.service8 on the /run/systemd/netif/io.systemd.Network socket; both are world-connectable (SocketMode=0666). Both methods authenticate through polkit, and interactive authentication is requested when the caller sets allowInteractiveAuthentication; the resolver uses the actions org.freedesktop.resolve1.set-dns-servers and org.freedesktop.resolve1.set-domains, networkd the corresponding org.freedesktop.network1.set-dns-servers and org.freedesktop.network1.set-domains actions. In practice the caller of the resolver's copy is systemd-networkd.service8, which forwards the DNS configuration it learned from the network.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Resolve.Link
type ResolveSupport( # The protocol is disabled. no, # The protocol is enabled. yes, # The protocol is used only for resolving. resolve )
type DNSOverTLSMode( # DNSOverTLS is disabled. no, # DNSOverTLS is enabled. yes, # Try to use DNSOverTLS, but disabled when the server does not support it. opportunistic )
# DNS server configuration input. type DNSServerContext( # IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server. address: []int, # Address family of the server, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: int, # Port number of the server. port: ?int, # Interface index for which this server is configured. ifindex: ?int, # Server Name Indication (SNI) of the server. name: ?string )
# Search domain configuration input. type SearchDomainContext( # DNS search or route domain name name: string, # Indicates if this is a routing-only domain. routeOnly: ?bool )
# Set the per-link DNS server list. method SetDNS( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # DNS servers to configure on the link servers: []DNSServerContext ) -> ()
# Set the per-link search domain list. method SetDomains( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # DNS search or route domains to configure on the link. searchDomains: []SearchDomainContext ) -> ()
# Set the per-link DNSSEC negative trust anchors. method SetDNSSECNegativeTrustAnchors( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # DNSSEC negative trust anchors to configure on the link negativeTrustAnchors: []string ) -> ()
# Set the per-link DNS default route setting. method SetDNSDefaultRoute( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # Whether this link can be used as a default route for DNS lookups. defaultRoute: bool ) -> ()
# Set the per-link LLMNR mode. method SetLLMNR( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # LLMNR mode to configure on the link. llmnr: ResolveSupport ) -> ()
# Set the per-link MulticastDNS mode. method SetMulticastDNS( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # MulticastDNS mode to configure on the link. mDNS: ResolveSupport ) -> ()
# Set the per-link DNS-over-TLS mode. method SetDNSOverTLS( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # DNSOverTLS mode to configure on the link. Passing null resets to the default. dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode ) -> ()
# Set the per-link DNSSEC mode. method SetDNSSEC( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int, # DNSSEC mode to configure on the link. Passing null resets to the default. dnssec: ?string ) -> ()
# Revert per-link DNS settings. method RevertDNS( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Index of the interface to configure. ifindex: int ) -> ()
# The specified interface is managed by systemd-networkd. The request should be re-directed to systemd-networkd. error ManagedByNetworkd()
# The specified interface is a loopback interface, and cannot be configured. error IsLoopback()
# The specified interface is not ready yet, e.g. its name is not known. The request should be retried later. error InterfaceNotReady()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve.Link shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve.Link.SetDNS \ '{"ifindex": 2, "servers": [{"address": [127, 0, 0, 1], "family": 2, "port": 53}]}' invokes its SetDNS() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Resolve.Link interface was added in version 263.

DNSOverTLSMode, DNSServerContext, InterfaceNotReady, IsLoopback, ManagedByNetworkd, ResolveSupport, RevertDNS(), SearchDomainContext, SetDNS(), SetDNSDefaultRoute(), SetDNSOverTLS(), SetDNSSEC(), SetDNSSECNegativeTrustAnchors(), SetDomains(), SetLLMNR(), and SetMulticastDNS() were added in version 263.
